description: Analyze IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnets for range collisions, full containment, 2D bit-tree matrix partition, and available free subnet allocation.

cidrs.description: Array of IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR strings to analyze for collisions and tree partition.

parent_cidr.description: Optional parent CIDR string (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16) to constrain free subnet allocation search.

requested_free_prefix.description: Optional target prefix length (e.g. 20, 24) to find available free subnet block inside parent range.

name: calculate_cidr_overlap
title: Calculate CIDR Overlap
